work.description: Act VIII is complete through datum LF10434–10437. Its own marginal date and beginning summary LF10149–10160 are displaced before the preceding act closes; they are retained disjointly, while the preceding act body and running titles/page numbers are excluded. XML leaf55 places date/summaries in the left margin at x28–238, separately from VII body and beside VIII beginning. No substantive cross-reference omission was found. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
